what: Oil tanker hijacked off coast of Yemen and taken towards Somalia

clean_source_blocks.text: The Yemeni coastguard earlier said the tanker MT Eureka had been hijacked and was headed towards Somalia. Sources said it was overrun by pirates in the Gulf of Aden, near the port of Qana.
It is the second time an oil tanker has been hijacked in the area in the past 10 days.

Authorities in Yemen said an oil tanker was hijacked off the coast of Shabwa province and was being taken toward Somali waters, raising fresh concerns over maritime security in one of the world’s most sensitive shipping corridors.
Somali pirates have hijacked an oil tanker off the coast of Yemen, according to multiple Somali security officials that spoke with the BBC.
